name: PM MUDRA Yojana - Shishu
shortDesc: Collateral-free micro loan for a new or very small business.

benefit.summary: Up to Rs 50,000 with no collateral and no processing fee at most public banks.

notes: Non-farm income-generating activity, or allied agriculture (not crop loans).
The lending bank still assesses repayment capacity.

name: PM MUDRA Yojana - Kishore
shortDesc: Collateral-free loan for a business that is already running.

benefit.summary: Rs 50,001 to Rs 5,00,000 with no collateral, for an existing micro enterprise.

notes: Banks usually expect some business vintage and turnover proof at this ticket size.

name: PM MUDRA Yojana - Tarun
shortDesc: Largest MUDRA tier, for an established micro enterprise.

benefit.summary: Rs 5,00,001 to Rs 10,00,000, collateral-free under the CGFMU guarantee.

name: PM MUDRA Yojana - Tarun Plus
shortDesc: Higher MUDRA tier for borrowers who repaid an earlier Tarun loan.

benefit.summary: Rs 10,00,001 to Rs 20,00,000 for entrepreneurs with a clean Tarun repayment record.

notes: Requires a previously availed and fully repaid Tarun-category MUDRA loan.

name: PM SVANidhi - First Tranche
shortDesc: Working capital loan for street vendors, no collateral.
authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

benefit.summary: Rs 10,000 working capital, repayable in 12 monthly instalments, with 7% interest subsidy and a cashback for digital payments.

notes: Needs a Certificate of Vending or an ID card from the Urban Local Body.
Vendors surveyed but without a certificate can get a provisional letter of recommendation.

documents: Certificate of Vending or ULB ID card
searchKeywords: PM Svanidhi Yojana street vendor loan

name: PM SVANidhi - Second Tranche
shortDesc: Second street-vendor loan after the first is repaid on time.
authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

benefit.summary: Rs 20,000 for vendors who repaid the Rs 10,000 tranche on schedule.

notes: Requires timely repayment of the first tranche.

name: PM SVANidhi - Third Tranche
shortDesc: Third street-vendor loan for a clean repayment history.
authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

benefit.summary: Rs 50,000 for vendors who repaid both earlier tranches.

notes: Requires timely repayment of the first and second tranches.

documents: Repayment record for both prior tranches

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
shortDesc: Capital subsidy plus bank loan to set up a new micro enterprise.

benefit.summary: Government subsidy of 15-35% of project cost (higher for SC/ST/women/rural), with project cost up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for service units.

notes: Only for NEW units. An existing or already-subsidised unit is not eligible.
Class VIII pass required for manufacturing projects above Rs 10 lakh and service projects above Rs 5 lakh.
Beneficiary contributes 5-10% of project cost.

searchKeywords: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme subsidy

name: Stand-Up India
shortDesc: Greenfield enterprise loan for SC, ST and women entrepreneurs.

benefit.summary: Composite loan of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for a first-time (greenfield) enterprise, with a moratorium and credit guarantee cover.

notes: Open to SC/ST applicants of any gender and to women of any category.
Must be a greenfield project - the applicant's first venture in manufacturing, services, trading or allied agriculture.
For a non-individual entity, 51% shareholding must be held by an SC/ST or woman promoter.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
shortDesc: Short-term crop credit at a heavily subsidised interest rate.

benefit.summary: Revolving credit up to Rs 3 lakh at 7% with a further 3% rebate for prompt repayment, so an effective 4%. Collateral-free up to Rs 2 lakh.

notes: Covers owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers.
Also extended to animal husbandry and fisheries activities.

name: PM-KISAN
shortDesc: Direct income support for landholding farmer families.
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefit.summary: Rs 6,000 a year paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 directly into the bank account.

notes: Landholding farmer families. Institutional landholders are excluded.
Income-tax payers, serving or retired government employees above a pay threshold, and professionals are excluded.
e-KYC and land-record seeding must be complete or instalments are withheld.

name: PM Vishwakarma
shortDesc: Toolkit grant, skill training and cheap credit for traditional artisans.

benefit.summary: Collateral-free credit of Rs 1 lakh, then Rs 2 lakh on repayment, at 5% interest, plus a toolkit incentive and a skill-training stipend.

notes: Applicant must work in one of the 18 notified trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, cobbler, tailor, barber and others).
Only one member per family. Government employees and their families are excluded.
Registration is through a Common Service Centre with ULB or Gram Panchayat verification.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
shortDesc: Credit-linked capital subsidy for small food processing units.

benefit.summary: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy on eligible project cost, capped at Rs 10 lakh per unit, plus branding and marketing support.

notes: For micro food processing enterprises, including single-product units under the One District One Product approach.
Beneficiary contributes at least 10% of project cost; the rest is a bank loan.

searchKeywords: PM FME micro food processing subsidy

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
shortDesc: Central subsidy for a rooftop solar system on a home.
authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

benefit.summary: Subsidy up to Rs 78,000 for a 3 kW rooftop solar system, with concessional collateral-free loans available for residential installations.

notes: Applicant must own a residential house with a suitable roof and a valid electricity connection.
Installation must be done by a DISCOM-registered vendor for the subsidy to be released.

searchKeywords: Muft Bijli Yojana rooftop solar subsidy

name: PM E-DRIVE
shortDesc: Purchase incentive on electric two- and three-wheelers.

benefit.summary: Demand incentive applied at the dealer on eligible electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, ambulances, trucks and buses. The amount depends on battery capacity and vehicle category.

notes: The incentive is claimed by the dealer against an Aadhaar-authenticated e-voucher, not reimbursed to the buyer later.
Only models and OEMs certified under the scheme qualify.
Scheme has a fixed outlay and a defined window - verify the incentive is still live before relying on it.

searchKeywords: PM E DRIVE electric vehicle subsidy

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
shortDesc: Government guarantee that lets a bank lend to you without collateral.

benefit.summary: Guarantee cover on credit facilities to micro and small enterprises, letting banks lend without collateral or third-party guarantee.

notes: You do not apply directly. The lending bank applies for cover on your loan, so ask your bank to route it under CGTMSE.
Retail trade and educational or training institutions have historically been outside the cover - confirm current eligibility.

documents: Loan application to a member lending institution
searchKeywords: credit guarantee scheme micro small enterprises

name: National Livestock Mission - Entrepreneurship Development
shortDesc: Capital subsidy to start a poultry, goat, sheep, piggery or fodder unit.
authority: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying

benefit.summary: 50% capital subsidy on the project, released in two instalments, with limits that vary by activity (poultry, small ruminant, piggery, fodder).

notes: Individuals, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs, FCOs and Section 8 companies can apply.
Requires land ownership or a registered lease and a bank appraisal of the project.

name: PM Vidyalaxmi
shortDesc: Collateral-free education loan with interest subvention.

benefit.summary: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loan for admission to a listed quality higher-education institution, with a 3% interest subvention for families under the income threshold.

notes: Admission must be to an institution on the scheme's quality list.
The full interest subvention benefit is tied to the family income slab - check the current slab before applying.

name: NHFDC Divyangjan Swavalamban Scheme
shortDesc: Concessional self-employment loan for persons with disabilities.
authority: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation

benefit.summary: Concessional-interest loan for self-employment, with lower rates for smaller ticket sizes and additional concessions for women applicants.

notes: Requires a disability certificate showing 40% or more benchmark disability.

name: Maharashtra EV Policy - Purchase Incentive
shortDesc: State top-up incentive on electric vehicles registered in Maharashtra.

benefit.summary: State purchase incentive stacked on top of the central EV incentive, with amounts varying by vehicle category and battery capacity.

notes: Vehicle must be registered in Maharashtra.
State EV policies are revised and paused often - the freshness check on this card matters more than the stated amount.

name: Gujarat Electric Vehicle Subsidy
shortDesc: State subsidy on electric two- and three-wheelers in Gujarat.

benefit.summary: Per-kWh state subsidy on eligible electric two- and three-wheelers, capped per vehicle category.

notes: Vehicle must be purchased and registered in Gujarat.
Verify the current policy window before relying on the amount.

name: Tamil Nadu MSME Capital Subsidy
shortDesc: State capital subsidy on plant and machinery for MSMEs in Tamil Nadu.
authority: MSME Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

benefit.summary: Capital subsidy on eligible plant and machinery, with higher rates for units set up by women, SC/ST, transgender and differently-abled entrepreneurs and for backward districts.

notes: Unit must be located in Tamil Nadu and registered on Udyam.
Subsidy rates and district classifications are revised periodically.

documents: Factory licence or local body approval
